Cell-surface-capture protein panel AMO1Inputs

Source: R/data-glyhub_PMC9287322_N_AMO1Inputs.R
glyhub_PMC9287322_N_AMO1Inputs.Rd

Cell-surface-capture protein panel AMO1Inputs

Usage

glyhub_PMC9287322_N_AMO1Inputs(
  kind = c("curated", "raw"),
  cache_dir = getOption("glyhub.cache_dir", tools::R_user_dir("glyhub", "cache")),
  refresh = FALSE,
  offline = FALSE
)

Format

A glyexp::GlycoproteomicSE with 1248 source rows and 12 measurements.

Source

https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-022-31810-6. CC BY 4.0 author supplement; see license_evidence.json

Arguments

kind

"curated" returns a data object; "raw" returns the path to a verified source file. Here "raw" means the source asset, not necessarily instrument-raw or unprocessed intensity. Some literature sources contain signed author-processed matrices and have no curated object.

cache_dir

Cache directory, defaulting to tools::R_user_dir("glyhub", "cache"). Set option glyhub.cache_dir to change the default.

refresh

Download the pinned resource again, even if cached.

offline

Prohibit downloads; require a verified local resource.

Details

Preserve complete selected author-processed matrix on its supplied log2(iBAQ+1) scale; no new filtering, imputation or transformation. Same study/source family, not independent cohorts. CellLineSurfaceome partly reuses PXD016800 leukemia data; exact shared-control run overlap across panels unresolved because official sample-list downloads failed. Original sample labels, patient input titration and methods preserved; do not infer independence. Preserve every author row, including repeated protein labels; do not deduplicate or infer quantified glycans/sites. These panels share a study source family and are not independent cohorts; accession mapping is retained per source table.

Source scale: author log2(iBAQ+1) protein surfaceome abundance.

All original selected source numbers are retained in the assay and metadata(x)$raw_abundance, including zeros and missing values. No additional normalization, imputation or inverse transformation is applied. No glycan structures are inferred. Consult metadata for provenance, source row/column coordinates, attribution and limitations.

Availability

Available from the versioned data-v0.2.0 GitHub data release. Downloads are verified by file size and SHA-256 and cached for offline reuse.
